title: Jellicle albums for Jellicle cats!
transcript: Y'all, we freaking did it! We freaking did it! Cats the Jellicle ball is getting a cast album! I'm so, so, so excited. And I really hope you all realise how rare it is for a revival to announce a cast album this late into the run. Often times, cast albums are seen as marketing tools, not tools of preservation, which they absolutely are. And especially for a revival, if the original production already has a cast album, they just don't feel like enough people care to get a new cast recording. And we made it known that we do care and it is, in fact, getting a cast album. So thank you to everyone who shared the post and signed the petitions and tagged the people and commented on on the official Instagram. This is happening because we demanded it. And if I could be petty for just a second, absolutely no thanks to all of y'all that saw people trying to do something good in this world and met it with negativity. I'm so happy this cast album is happening, and a huge congratulations to this cast. They deserve this and frankly, so much more. Have an incredible final week of what is absolutely an incredible production, and I cannot wait to blast this cast album.
